'''''Mother Ithor''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]] named for the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] homeworld, [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].

==Characteristics==
''Mother Ithor'' was similar to almost every other [[Ithorian Herdship]], being a huge flattened ball which was designed to simulate the jungles of Ithor, the Ithorian homeworld, in a space-worthy vessel.

==History==
''Mother Ithor'' traded with planets on the border of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It would often venture into these regions in order to provide relief to the oppressed people within.
